intro_html:
Hi! I am Xue Liu, a third-year undergraduate student in Electronic Information Engineering at Nanjing University of Science and Technology (NJUST).

My research focuses on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), especially inference-time hallucination mitigation. I am also interested in FPGA and embedded systems, and I enjoy building practical systems end to end.

Feel free to reach out if you share similar interests.
